question: Should the durable Dreaming scoping API be the newer global `plugins.entries.memory-core.config.dreaming.agents` allowlist, the originally requested `agents.list[].dreaming` override, or a broader scheduling/backpressure design?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the accepted config location and schedule semantics are product/API choices with compatibility impact and multiple open candidate PRs.

options.title: Land scoped allowlist first
options.body: Accept the newer global allowlist shape after the open PR's blocker is fixed, then track per-agent schedules or staggering separately.

options.title: Require per-agent overrides
options.body: Ask for the original `agents.list[].dreaming` contract instead, accepting a broader agent-config schema change.

options.title: Hold for scheduling design
options.body: Pause both PRs until maintainers choose between full per-agent cron, stagger offsets, and memory-pressure deferral.

recommendation.title: Land scoped allowlist first
recommendation.body: Accept the newer global allowlist shape after the open PR's blocker is fixed, then track per-agent schedules or staggering separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad ownership across Dreaming resolver/runtime/docs and config-sensitive memory-core changes.
